missed.fact: Claim 1's column list is incomplete. The full entity has 16 columns: id, text, dueAtIso, kind, repeatRuleKind, repeatIntervalMillis, nagEnabled, nagMaxRepeats, nagMaxDurationMillis, soundRef, done, notified, scheduleUpdatedAtMillis, scheduleUpdatedByDevice, statusUpdatedAtMillis, statusUpdatedByDevice, deletedAtMillis. The map omitted nagMaxRepeats, nagMaxDurationMillis, done, notified, both stamp pairs and deletedAtMillis. The nag columns matter for the merge.

repeatIntervalMillis packs three meanings into one nullable Long. EVERY_INTERVAL stores millis and WEEKDAYS stores a day bitmask. RANDOM_DAYS stores minDays*1000+maxDays, which the entity comment does not list. The entity comment says 'Null for every other repeat kind'.

RepeatRule has 7 variants: None, EveryInterval, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Weekdays and RandomDays. repeatRuleKind is a string name. EntityMappers decodes it and errors on an unknown name, so a merge must agree on these names.

The nag interval has no column. It is derived as maxDuration / maxRepeats, with a 60 s floor in NagAlarms. The sheet stores maxDuration = intervalMin * count, so the interval is recovered by division. The sheet offers 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes and counts of 2, 3, 5 and 10. Defaults are maxRepeats 3 and maxDuration 1 h. Nag stops after maxRepeats or when maxDuration elapses, not only on acknowledgement.

Snooze duration is an app-wide setting (alarmSettings.snoozeMinutes), not per reminder. Snooze state lives in device-local PendingAlerts plus a SnoozeAlarm slot, so it is not synced and there is no 'snoozed' column. Snoozing also cancels any nag chain in flight.
deletedAt is merged with the schedule group, not the status group. The entity has a separate deletedAtMillis column with no stamp of its own.

dueAt is wall-clock text, not an instant. It is stored as a fixed-width LocalDateTime string and resolved to an instant per zone at schedule time. A merge must compare or convert it as a string, not as millis.
Reminder implements Syncable with an override deletedAt: Instant? = null. The entity's deletedAtMillis is Long?.

ALARM kind effects: it always uses setAlarmClock, it schedules PreAlarmWarning, it rings via the AlarmService foreground service and AlarmActivity, and it picks TYPE_ALARM ringtones. NOTIFICATION kind uses setAlarmClock only if the useAlarmClockForNotifications setting is on.
